opening.argument: The speaker directly promotes the FastSage/Forsage Xcode program as an earning opportunity, identifying its “x3” and “x4” structures and urging viewers to participate. Xcode is described as a “good opportunity” to earn money, followed by the explicit instruction, “Join Farsage!” The appeal is reinforced by an unusually rapid wealth claim: the speaker associates the program with a community earning “Million of dollars ... In a few days.” Viewers are also given a direct joining pathway through the description and told to “Join F.A.S.T Farsage and earn Millions of Dollars.” These statements present tiered program structures, recruitment, and the prospect of millions of dollars within days as reasons to join.
